**Main result (as stated in index content).** Laplacians on arithmetic hyperbolic surfaces have Poisson rather than GOE level statistics despite chaotic geodesic flow, explained by exponentially large multiplicities of periodic-orbit lengths.

**Techniques.** periodic orbit theory; arithmetic groups

**Research potential (curator).** Warns which spectral models can mimic zero statistics; arithmetic degeneracy test.
